records.issue_text: Google Calendar derives the organizer attendee email from the first destination calendar, so events for secondary collective hosts identify the first host as organizer
records.rationale: The finding is accurate. In GoogleCalendarService.ts, the code extracts `mainHostDestinationCalendar` as the first element of the destinationCalendar array (lines 99-102, 197-198). This is then used to set the organizer email in the payload (lines 119-123, 225-228). For collective team events where multiple hosts have destination calendars, the organizer email will always be derived from the first
